check.name: DuplicateElseIfCondition
check.description: Checks that a condition is not repeated where it can never matter: an else if condition identical to an earlier condition in the same if-else-if chain. Such a branch is unreachable. Expressions that are mathematically or logically commutative (e.g. a + b vs b + a, or a && b vs b && a) or expressions with surrounding parentheses (e.g. x > 0 vs (x > 0)) produce different AST structures and are not considered duplicates.
